description: Every API key of the account: name, prefix, status, product-line permissions, account read permissions, per-minute limit, whether source IPs are restricted, expiry and last use. Never returns a full key; create, limit or disable keys in the console. Needs the account read permission "account:read" on this key: keys not limited to product lines have the three read permissions by default; for a key limited to product lines, the account owner turns it on in the console (API Keys → permissions). Free.
name: everyinfra_keys
title: List API keys
